chosen.change: Add ScheduleTiming, ScheduleTarget, ScheduleTargetRequest, paged ScheduleListResult, ScheduleViewRequest, SchedulePatch, ScheduleEditRequest, ScheduleRunRequest, and deleteInactive result. One service owns create, paged list, catalog, view, history, run, edit, and deleteInactive. Human remotes pass no actor session. Agent calls pass the acting session as involved only. Replace remote update and delete with edit. Cancellation is the request AbortSignal before the durable write. Do not add a second timer owner.

Deliver session, new_once, and new targets through the existing sessionController.resolveAgent and sessionController.create. Enqueue with source kind schedule. A new target records pendingDelivery before create so a crash resumes that reserved id. Do not add schedule/resolve-agent.

Call the existing six record constructors from one ScheduleTiming dispatcher. Do not replace this file with the tag copy and do not add rrule evaluation.

State host storage version 2, the three targets, producer kind schedule, and that historical schedule/change events stay inert. Do not copy the tag page.
Keep the one schedules panel. Wire create, edit, run, history, and deleteInactive to the new remotes. New still starts a session. Manual create is a separate action inside the same page.
Open manual create in the existing detail pane. Catalog reads stay on the current source. Do not add a second page component.
Extend the existing rule form with target session, new_once, and new, plus title and prompt save through edit. Do not import the tag split or RRule controls.
Keep one catalog read. A schedule/changed notice or connection reset supersedes the read in flight. Do not start a second poller.

Update the child-session list and catalog expectations to the paged list and target catalog. The tag has no this path. Do not drop the fork subagent case.
